svg.title: Shared scheduling: when takeover is allowed
svg.desc: Claim, renewal and final writes verify database time and the active execution token. Takeover with the same occurrenceId requires declared safe retries and remaining attempts. Otherwise unknown pauses later occurrences for reconciliation. Lease expiry does not undo an HTTP request or other external effect.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
